parsed.explanation: Strong climate signals — self-declaration since 2021, a 2022 conversion-practices ban, marriage equality since 2013, a pioneering trans national officeholder — but these are resident-facing/climate at most. No documented traveller-facing restriction appears: no bathroom or facility ban, no border/document-marker friction, no custody placement rule, facilities unaddressed. The operative negative is documented societal hostility, trans-specific and current: police-recorded gender-identity hate incidents rose 42% (161→229, with police conceding undercount) and a national survey found ~1 in 5 trans/non-binary people threatened with violence and 8% physically assaulted in four years, alongside a 'worsening street climate' and event cancellations. That is tier-3 hostility, not tier-1 state exposure; institutions mostly function as protectors, though no prosecution of anti-trans attackers is documented. Unanswered border/custody questions are light. Sits just below the 0.65 anchors given the unremedied rising violence.
